Despite concerns over water pollution and toxic foam in the Yamuna, devotees continue to take a dip ahead of Chhath Puja in Delhi. Many say they are scared but cannot skip the ritual, choosing spots where the water appears cleaner and avoiding deeper stretches. Here's what the Yamuna looks like ahead of the festival. Watch
